# ibee_reserved_ip_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an existing reserved IP to a VM (POST .../attach). A change of vm_id, vpc_id or subnet_id is sent to the move operation. Destroy calls detach. Import as reserved_ip_id/vm_id.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_reserved_ip_attachment" "public" {
  reserved_ip_id = "RESERVED_IP_ID"
  vm_id          = "VM_ID"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `reserved_ip_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `subnet_id` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted |  |
| `vm_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `vpc_id` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted |  |

## Import
